boundary.name: reenqueue_at_max_jobs

notes: Closed fixture for the T0284 jobs-queue contract: pinned receipts and committed states computed by the reference engine; malformed rows cover every failure class with a single-locus minimal repair; rollback rows prove a rejected transition leaves state and request bit-identical before a valid follow-up. The max_jobs capacity edge (10000 jobs) is exercised by the reenqueue_at_max_jobs boundary row; rows are stored one per line.
